comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Apart from the recipe, this is also sold for 10,000 ducats in the following item shops:

London: Appears in 5th period, 15th Century through 3rd Period of the 16th Century
Lisbon: Appears in 5th period, 15th Century through 2nd Period of the 16th Century
Venice: Appears in 5th period, 15th Century through 2nd Period of the 16th Century

With the correct Adept of Ages title, or the World Clock set to an era somewhere in that range, they become available for purchase.
